findings.text: only three of the six negative controls the section's Done when declares were executed (mutation runs A, B and C, covering reading test_logs as one entry, splitting test_logs alone and leaving commits unsplit); the controls for refusing any mention of baseline_suite (seventh case), refusing any baseline_suite: { not glued (eighth case) and restating the field list as literals (tenth case) were never run, so the done_when's 'every case and negative control' is unmet and the ledger-owned field list is guarded by a passing test rather than demonstrated to fail when restated.
_SUITE_ARM_KEYS is defined and read nowhere in the tree, duplicating the same pair that promotion_evidence.py:1360 _SUITE_ARM_NAMES carries, so the arm vocabulary has an unused second declaration.

_split_entry_tokens duplicates the loop body of _split_on_whitespace at reckon/crew/reports.py:1075 rather than extending it with a predicate, leaving two whitespace-split helpers in one module and running both over commits.

_looks_like_a_list_entry_token accepts any token containing a separator, so the census's one sha-plus-parenthesised-paths commits line (r-20261003T011436676083-dry-run-picker-is-comparable) is split into fragments such as '(reckon/crew/dispatch.py' that no resolver can read, where the whole line was previously dropped whole.
